description:
The Company: 
Marigold is a fast-growing marketing technology company helping growing businesses build stronger customer relationships through its three core platforms: Emma, Campaign Monitor, and Vuture. We deliver powerful tools for email, SMS, and marketing automation that elevate engagement and drive real results. Marigold is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee with offices in Sydney and London.

 The Role: 
At Emma, we’re looking for a driven, curious software engineer to join our team. The Emma Engineering organization is made up of passionate engineers focused on building elegant, reliable tooling that helps our customers succeed in their email marketing efforts. Our teams operate with clear ownership boundaries, allowing engineers to specialize, deepen their expertise, and build sustainable software that’s easy to support and evolve over time. We take pride in crafting creative, scalable solutions for a wide range of customers—and we genuinely enjoy doing it together.

 This is an entry-level, Software Engineer role. On the frontend, we work primarily with React and supporting libraries, including a proprietary UI toolkit. Our backend systems are Python-driven, Django, and AWS-based. Experience in any of these areas is a plus, but a strong desire to learn and grow across the full stack is essential. Within your first six months, you’ll also have opportunities to contribute to additional areas of development as you continue to build your skills and expand your technical foundation.
  
 What You’ll Do:  
 Build and ship code that solves real problems for real customers. Engineering is central to what we do, and you’ll work closely with your team to plan, experiment, and deliver impactful solutions.
 Collaborate in code reviews, sharing ideas, learning from others, and helping raise the bar on quality and best practices.
 Get hands-on with how Emma builds intuitive, scalable tooling that helps marketing teams do their best work.
 Have fun while doing it!  We care deeply about our customers, move with intention, and genuinely enjoy building great products together.
 Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to research, prototype, and build, while learning how to apply them responsibly in a production codebase.
 
 About You: 
 You’re an early-career developer who’s excited to learn, grow, and contribute as part of a collaborative engineering team. While you may not be a master of React, Python, or AWS yet, you bring curiosity, strong potential, and a genuine desire to build your skills and learn best practices. You care deeply about technology, the products you help create, and the customers who rely on them. You enjoy variety in your work, are eager to take on new challenges, and are motivated by opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow alongside a supportive team. You're comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and you know that good engineering still means understanding, questioning, and owning the code you ship.

 Ideal Qualifications:  
 Early-career developer or recent graduate with a strong interest in software engineering
 Foundational experience or exposure to modern technologies such as React, Python, AWS, or similar tools
 Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, frameworks, and best practices
 Passion for building quality products with the end user in mind
 Comfortable working across different areas of the codebase and contributing where needed
 Strong collaboration skills and openness to feedback and continuous improvement
 Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to speed up your work, and able to critically review, test, and own the code they help produce
 
 Location Eligibility 
 This position is eligible for hire in the following US states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. 
 
 Compensation & Benefits 

 Compensation: 
The base salary range for this role is $70,000 -$80,000 annually.
 The compensation range represents the pay the Company reasonably expects to offer for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable law.

 Benefits:  
 Competitive benefits including: medical/dental/vision insurance, life/accident/disabilities insurance, supplemental health benefits, FSA, EAP and pet insurance
 Generous time off (we call it Open Time Away) as well as paid holidays and a birthday benefit day off.
 Paid Volunteer Time
 401k plan with a company match on your contributions.
 Employee-centric and supportive remote work environment with flexibility.
 Support for life events including paid parental leave.
